يستنزفوا (form X)
# يَسْتَنْزِفُوا (yastanzifū) /jas.tan.zi.fuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَنْزَفَ (istanzafa)
# يُسْتَنْزَفُوا (yustanzafū) /jus.tan.za.fuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَنْزَفَ (istanzafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
